name: Mad Monkes Remastered
summary:
Ready to play yet another VR monkey game? Welcome to Mad Monkes Remastered! This is a reimagining of the previous editions of the game, and the one that gets updated the most. Wander through the vast open forest, or take a trip up to the sky city in the clouds; the choice is yours!
This game aims to create a fun and immersive experience for it's players, with well-thought updates and a friendly and welcoming community.
